_note: Series-wide item types. kind is elixir | charm | hint | note | currency | plant | notebook. An optional 'icon' names a placeholder icon drawn in code (scenes/foraging/item_icon.gd). heal_units is in half-hearts (rules.json half_units_per_heart). Items with usable false cannot be used yet. kind plant is a plant a finished word gives (view-only in the backpack); kind notebook is the 수첩, the only item that opens a view (the notes inside it). Note items are not listed here: Content registers them from data/notes/*.json (kind note).
